meta.name: agiled-automation
meta.description: Automate Agiled tasks via Rube MCP (Composio). Always search tools first for current schemas.

copy.tagline: 自动执行 Agiled 中的重复任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用 Agiled 管理业务并希望自动执行常规操作
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you use Agiled for business management and want to automate routine operations

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 可以通过 Rube MCP 自动操作 Agiled 系统（如创建合同、管理客户），执行前会先搜索当前可用的工具并检查连接状态。
howto.when: 当你要求执行 Agiled 相关任务（如“在 Agiled 中创建合同”），且已安装并连接 Rube MCP 和 Agiled 时触发。

say.text: 在 Agiled 中创建一个新合同。
say.note: Claude 会先搜索工具，然后执行创建合同操作。

say.text: 列出 Agiled 中最近 5 个客户。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并返回客户列表。

say.text: 更新 Agiled 项目“市场推广”的状态为“进行中”。
say.note: Claude 会搜索工具并执行更新操作。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can automate Agiled tasks (e.g., create contracts, manage clients) via Rube MCP. It first searches for available tools and verifies the connection before executing.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you request Agiled-related tasks (e.g., "Create a contract in Agiled") and Rube MCP with an active Agiled connection is installed.

say_en.text: Create a new contract in Agiled.
say_en.note: Claude searches tools then creates the contract.

say_en.text: List the 5 most recent clients in Agiled.
say_en.note: Claude searches tools and returns the client list.

say_en.text: Update the project 'Marketing' status to 'In Progress' in Agiled.
say_en.note: Claude searches tools and performs the update.
